{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check the distribution of species by island
df_grouped = df.groupby(['species', 'island']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
print('Species by island:')
print(df_grouped)

# Check mean flipper length by island
df_flipper_island = df.groupby('island')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
print('\nMean flipper length by island:')
print(df_flipper_island)

# Check mean flipper length by species (without adjustment)
df_flipper_species = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
print('\nMean flipper length by species (unadjusted):')
print(df_flipper_species)

# Check mean flipper length by species within each island
# This is the stratified analysis
df_flipper_stratified = df.groupby(['island', 'species'])['flipper_length_mm'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
print('\nMean flipper length by species within each island:')
print(df_flipper_stratified)"}
